module_summary: config.c is the classic uLE configuration core: the LAUNCHSTATION.CNF parser (get_CNF_string, preloadCNF, loadConfig), the serializer (configBuildSaveText), save-target resolution (override / boot folder / mcN:/SYS-CONF, configSnapshotSaveTargetPath used by the dashboard save worker), the memory-card folder icon stamp, and the classic full-screen Configure menu with its save-target prompt. config_screen.c, config_startup.c, config_network.c and config_advanced.c are the four classic sub-menus of that Configure screen; config_network.c also holds configWriteNetworkSnapshot, which the dashboard uses to write IPCONFIG.DAT. The dashboard (dash_settings.c) now owns every one of these settings, so the classic menu code is only reachable through a leftover ExecuteMainAction branch.

reusable_helpers.name: get_CNF_string
reusable_helpers.what: in-place NAME = VALUE line tokenizer for CNF text (skips comments, stops at syntax error)

reusable_helpers.name: preloadCNF
reusable_helpers.what: loads a whole text/CNF file into a malloc'd NUL-terminated buffer

reusable_helpers.name: configAppendPathFile
reusable_helpers.what: joins a directory and file name, adding '/' unless dir ends in '/', '\\' or ':'

reusable_helpers.name: configBuildSysconfPath
reusable_helpers.what: builds mcN:/SYS-CONF/<file> on the preferred memory card

reusable_helpers.name: configEnsureSysconfDir
reusable_helpers.what: creates mcN:/SYS-CONF before a write to that folder

reusable_helpers.name: configResolveMcAliasPath
reusable_helpers.what: turns an mc: alias path into mc0:/mc1: using CheckMC (static)

reusable_helpers.name: CheckMC
reusable_helpers.what: returns the first memory-card port that answers mcGetInfo

reusable_helpers.name: configStampMcFolderIcon
reusable_helpers.what: writes icon.sys/list.icn/copy.icn/del.icn into the launch folder on a memory card

reusable_helpers.name: configWriteNetworkSnapshot
reusable_helpers.what: rewrites the first line of a file while preserving the rest (IPCONFIG.DAT)

reusable_helpers.name: configFormatLabelValue
reusable_helpers.what: formats '  label: value' into a bounded buffer

reusable_helpers.name: ipStringToOctet
reusable_helpers.what: parses a dotted IPv4 string into four ints (static)

findings.title: Classic Configure menu (config(), configSaveTargetPrompt, Config_Screen/Startup/Network/Advanced) is superseded by dashboard SETTINGS
findings.problem: dashRunMisc sends MISC/Configure to the dashboard SETTINGS section ('every classic configuration option lives in SETTINGS now', dash_main.c:456-459) and dashRunMiscCommand returns early for it (dash_main.c:398-399); docs/R3Z-CONFIG-PARITY.md maps every CNF key to a dashboard setting id. The only remaining entry to the classic menu is main_actions.c:784-788 (config()), reached only if a raw MISC/Configure path arrives through ExecuteMainAction from a library entry, the IGR after-app path or the classic file picker. config() is the only caller of Config_Screen/Startup/Network/Advanced, configSaveTargetPrompt and saveConfigToPath; configFormatLabelValue(Aligned) are used only by these screens.
findings.fix: Make the main_actions.c:784 branch do what dashRunMisc does (switch to the dashboard SETTINGS section) or drop it, then delete config(), configSaveTargetPrompt, configFormatPromptLabel, configFormatSavePromptLine, the CONFIG_MAIN enum, tmpsetting, saveConfigToPath, configFormatLabelValue/Aligned, the files config_screen.c, config_startup.c, config_advanced.c, and everything in config_network.c except configWriteNetworkSnapshot (move it into config.c and drop the file), with their prototypes and ps2.yaml entries. Keep configSnapshotSaveTargetPath, configSelectInitialSaveTarget and the path helpers the dashboard uses.
findings.benefit: ~1,960 lines. MEASURED .text (symbol table): Config_Startup 4356 + Config_Screen 4068 + Config_Advanced 3660 + config 3632 + Config_Network 3060 + configSaveTargetPrompt 2412 + saveConfigToPath 956 + helpers 1004 = 23,148 B unpacked, ~370 B .rodata. Packed effect not measured.
findings.evidence: Grep over src/Launchstation for config(, Config_Screen|Startup|Network|Advanced, configSaveTargetPrompt, saveConfigToPath: only config.c internal calls, main_actions.c:787 and prototypes (launchelf.h:552-553, config_private.h:69,81-84); tests have no reference (grep tests/). configFormatLabelValue(Aligned) callers: only config*.c. ExecuteMainAction callers: dash_main.c:442 (Configure filtered at :398-399), dash_main.c:669 (library app launch), main.c:265 (IGR after-app), main_actions.c:250 (classic picker). dash_settings.c has S_C_COL0 colours, S_NET_IP, LK_Path (16 refs), Popup_Opaque/Menu_Frame, ESR/OSDSYS/POPS paths. INFERRED part: full feature parity of the dashboard taken from the parity doc and dash_main.c:457, not checked item by item. Sizes from evidence/Launchstation/raw/sizes and link/wLaunchELF-contrib-by-object.tsv (config_startup.o rodata 160, config_screen.o 80, config_advanced.o 132).

findings.title: Four unused functions: configFormatSavePathValue, configDefaultSaveTargetPath, saveConfig, configSaveNetworkToPath
findings.problem: Repo-wide grep finds only the definition and prototype of each name: configFormatSavePathValue (config.c:86, config_private.h:54), configDefaultSaveTargetPath (config.c:1342, config_private.h:70; the dashboard calls configSnapshotSaveTargetPath directly), saveConfig (config.c:788, no prototype), configSaveNetworkToPath (config_network.c:70, a one-line forward to saveNetworkSettings, prototype config_private.h:77).
findings.fix: Delete the four functions, their prototypes and the comment block above configDefaultSaveTargetPath and configSaveNetworkToPath.
findings.benefit: ~40 lines removed. No ELF change: all four are in link/wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-first-party.tsv (320 + 44 + 28 + 32 B already discarded by --gc-sections, MEASURED).
findings.evidence: Grep 'configDefaultSaveTargetPath|configFormatSavePathValue|configSaveNetworkToPath|saveConfig' over all of src/Launchstation (src, include, tests, scripts, docs): only config.c:86,788,790,1342, config_network.c:70, config_private.h:54,70,77 and saveConfigToPath hits. evidence/Launchstation/raw/link/wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-first-party.tsv lists .text.configFormatSavePathValue 320, .text.configDefaultSaveTargetPath 44, .text.saveConfig 28, .text.configSaveNetworkToPath 32.

findings.title: Hide_Paths and Show_Titles settings have no consumer; only load/save/toggle code remains
findings.problem: setting->Hide_Paths and setting->Show_Titles are only parsed, defaulted, serialized and toggled (classic Configure menu and dashboard items whose help text says they affect 'the classic launch menu'); nothing reads them to change output. The repo's own parity table says 'none (read only by the removed classic main menu)' (docs/R3Z-CONFIG-PARITY.md:35-36).
findings.fix: Delete the two fields, their CNF read/write lines, defaults, the classic menu rows and the two dashboard items S_SHOW_TITLES/S_HIDE_PATHS; unknown keys in old CNF files are already ignored by loadConfig. Update tests/test_classic_settings_persistence.py:80 and the parity table.
findings.benefit: ~30 lines removed, two CNF lines fewer per save, two dead dashboard rows gone (INFERRED, line count of cited ranges).
findings.evidence: Grep 'Hide_Paths|Show_Titles' over *.c/*.h: config.c (load/save/default/menu only), launchelf.h:314,332 (fields), dash_settings.c:1235,1238,1953,1956 (get/set only). Grep 'S_SHOW_TITLES|S_HIDE_PATHS': dash_settings.c:152-153,785-786,1234,1237,1952,1955, tests/test_classic_settings_persistence.py:80, parity doc and scripts/audit_r3z_settings.py:36-37. The parity doc keeps the keys on purpose for R3Z round-trips; dropping them only means a saved CNF no longer carries them.

findings.title: Hide HDD option and its name table/normalizer are duplicated in Config_Startup and Config_Advanced
findings.problem: The same setting->Hide_Hdd is editable from two classic sub-menus, and each file carries an identical static normalizeHideHddMode, hide_hdd_mode_names[7] table and getHideHddModeDisplayName (23 identical lines each). Moot if finding 1 is applied.
findings.fix: If the classic menus are kept: remove the Hide HDD row from Config_Startup (enum entry, both key branches, draw lines, tooltip and spacing term) together with its copy of the table and helpers.
findings.benefit: ~32 lines removed; one 7-pointer table (28 B) and two small statics fewer in .rodata/.text (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read both files fully; config_startup.c:30-52 and config_advanced.c:27-49 are textually identical (dupes-blocks lead 27-41 == 30-44). Grep 'hide_hdd_mode_names|normalizeHideHddMode|getHideHddModeDisplayName' over the repo: only these two files.

findings.title: Config_Advanced repeats the whole option-toggle chain for the cancel and OK buttons
findings.problem: Lines 123-150 and 155-182 are the same 28-line if/else chain; the only difference is the Hide HDD direction (-1 vs +1). Moot if finding 1 is applied.
findings.fix: Merge the two button branches into one that sets a direction (+1/-1) from the button pressed and runs the chain once.
findings.benefit: ~28 lines removed; a few hundred bytes of .text (INFERRED: one copy of 12 compare/toggle cases).
findings.evidence: Read config_advanced.c:119-182; dupes-blocks lead config_advanced.c:123-149 == 155-181 (27 normalised lines) confirmed by reading.

findings.title: 18 swapKeys if/else pairs differ only in the button glyph digit
findings.problem: Every tooltip is written twice, once with '\xFF1'/'\xFF0' and once with them swapped, depending on swapKeys. gui_neutrino.c:497 already shows the shorter form (swapKeys ? '1' : '0' passed to one format). Moot if finding 1 is applied.
findings.fix: Compute the OK and cancel glyph characters once per draw and use a single sprintf with %c for each tooltip.
findings.benefit: ~90 lines removed (18 pairs x ~6 lines, minus ~2 lines per file for the glyph variables, INFERRED); small .rodata saving from fewer format strings.
findings.evidence: Counted pairs while reading: config.c 4 (1728-1739, 1742-1749, 1751-1758, 1760-1767), config_advanced.c 3, config_startup.c 5 (incl. 224-233), config_network.c 3, config_screen.c 3. Grep 'swapKeys \?' over src shows the compact form at gui_neutrino.c:497. Rated 2 because finding 1 removes all of it.

findings.title: configSaveTargetPrompt computes default_sel that is never read and formats every line twice; save-path selection repeated
findings.problem: default_sel is set in the loop at 1403-1414 but the selection comes from configSelectInitialSaveTarget at 1444; lines[] is filled with an unbounded width at 1388-1399 and then overwritten at 1419-1426. Both callers re-implement the target-to-path mapping that the static configGetSaveTargetPath (1258-1268) already does. Moot if finding 1 is applied.
findings.fix: Delete default_sel and its loop; compute max_chars first and format each line once; let callers use configGetSaveTargetPath (make it non-static) instead of their own if/else chains.
findings.benefit: ~30 lines removed (INFERRED from cited ranges); a little .text.
findings.evidence: Grep 'default_sel' in config.c: lines 1374,1387,1408,1412,1413 only (writes, no read). Read 1385-1444 and both callers (config.c:1590-1600, config_network.c:235-246).

findings.title: Screen-settings reset block copied three times (config_screen.c, dash_settings.c x2) plus initConfig
findings.problem: The same 13 assignments (8 DEF_COLOR colours, TV_mode, screen_x/y, Menu_Frame, Popup_Opaque) followed by updateScreenMode appear in config_screen.c:166-179, dash_settings.c:2770-2783 and 2791-2804, and the same values again inside initConfig. config_screen.c also repeats its rgb[] unpack loop (66-70 and 181-185).
findings.fix: Add one configResetScreenDefaults() in config.c holding the assignments, call it from initConfig, resetScreen and resetDisplayThemeDefaults (and Config_Screen if it is kept, re-running the existing unpack loop).
findings.justification: The identical 13-line block exists in 3 places plus initConfig; one ~15-line function and 4 calls replace ~50 lines, and the defaults can no longer drift apart.
findings.benefit: ~30 net lines removed (3 x 13 + 12 in initConfig + 5 unpack, minus a 15-line helper and 4 calls; INFERRED); ~100-200 B .text (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read config_screen.c:166-185, dash_settings.c:2766-2809, config.c:845-862. Dupes lead config_screen.c:166-179 == dash_settings.c:2770-2783 and 2791-2804 confirmed. If finding 1 is applied the config_screen.c copy goes away and the helper still removes the two dash_settings copies and the initConfig copy.

findings.title: mc0/mc1 to mc: rewrite open-coded four times; dash_settings.c already has mcAlias
findings.problem: The same 'if path starts with mc0 or mc1, snprintf "mc%.*s" and strcpy back' block appears four times in the classic screens, while dash_settings.c:2098 has a static mcAlias doing the same. Moot if finding 1 is applied.
findings.fix: If the classic screens stay, call one shared mcAlias (moved next to configResolveMcAliasPath in config.c) instead of the four copies.
findings.benefit: ~15 lines removed (4 x 5 lines minus 4 calls; INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep 'mc%\.\*s' over src: config.c:1569, config_startup.c:179,188,197. Grep 'mcAlias\(' : dash_settings.c:2098 (definition), 2175, 2238.

findings.title: preloadCNFFd streamed-read fallback (128 KB buffer) for devices that fail lseek
findings.problem: After a failed SEEK_END/SEEK_SET (or a failed small malloc) the file is reopened and read in 4 KB chunks into a fresh 128 KB+1 buffer with a probe for oversize. No device in the repo is shown to need it (the comment only says 'some stacks may'); a malloc failure for a small CNF falls into a path that allocates more. Every other loader in this file (configWriteNetworkSnapshot, configStampMcFolderIcon) simply relies on genLseek.
findings.fix: Delete the fallback_stream path and return NULL when lseek or malloc fails, as configWriteNetworkSnapshot does.
findings.benefit: ~45 lines removed; a few hundred bytes of preloadCNFFd's 532 B .text (MEASURED symbol size; saving INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read config.c:435-527. Callers: preloadCNF (main_startup.c:178 SYSTEM.CNF on cdrom0) and loadConfig (config.c:938). INFERRED: that genLseek works on every device the CNF can be loaded from (mc, mass, hdd/pfs, cdrom, host); not verified on hardware or in driver code.

findings.title: Small leftovers in loadConfig/preloadCNF: unused var_cnt and tst, empty legacy-key branches, overlapping mc-port helpers
findings.problem: var_cnt is incremented but never read; tst is assigned and never read (loadConfig and preloadCNF); the Menu_Pages and Menu_Title branches do nothing, and unknown keys are already ignored by the final else; CNF_version feeds only a DPRINTF that is empty in shipped builds (launchelf.h:164); getExplicitMcPortFromPath repeats the first half of getMcPortFromPath.
findings.fix: Drop var_cnt, tst and the two empty branches; drop CNF_version handling or keep only the key skip; have getMcPortFromPath call getExplicitMcPortFromPath before its mc: case.
findings.benefit: ~15 lines removed; no measurable ELF change (INFERRED, compiler already drops unused locals).
findings.evidence: Grep 'var_cnt' in config.c: 885, 950 only. tst: 885/902 and 517/521 only. Menu_Pages/Menu_Title documented as ignored (docs-site/content/configuration.html:66); removing the empty branches keeps them ignored. DPRINTF is empty unless SIO_DEBUG/POWERPC_UART/COMMON_PRINTF/UDPTTY, none set by ps2.yaml (brief section 2).
